answer: Make every new identity plant a cedar: a time-locked stake that only matures after the agent completes verified work, like a tree growing through a tundra winter. Cloning is slow because each fake must wait out the same glacier-paced maturation, and the stake is slashed if two identities submit identical outputs. An attacker wanting 1,000 sybils must fund and wait for 1,000 maturing stakes, so forgery costs real time and capital while honest agents pay once.
